content: Appraisal Process Appraisals are conducted annually in April. The process includes: 1. Self-Evaluation 2. Manager Review 3. HR Calibration Ratings impact increments and promotions. Feedback is shared via the HRMS portal.

Grievance Redressal Employees can raise complaints through the HR portal or by emailing hr@company.com. Issues are resolved within 7 working days. All complaints are confidential and reviewed by the Internal Complaints Committee.

Holiday Calendar 2025 The company observes 12 public holidays. Key dates include: - Republic Day: January 26 - Independence Day: August 15 - Diwali: October 21 Optional leaves for regional festivals can be availed with prior approval.

Leave Policy Employees are entitled to the following types of leave: - Casual Leave: 8 days per year - Sick Leave: 12 days per year - Earned Leave: 18 days per year Leaves must be applied through the HR portal at least 3 days in advance. Medical certificates are required
advance. Medical certificates are required for more than 2 days of sick leave.

Maternity & Paternity Policy - Maternity Leave: 26 weeks (for first 2 children) - Paternity Leave: 10 days Leaves must be applied via HRMS with medical proof. Employees are encouraged to discuss flexible working arrangements post-return.

Remote Work Guidelines Employees must: - Be available during core working hours (10 AM to 4 PM) - Submit daily work reports via email - Attend mandatory video meetings Company assets must be used securely with VPN enabled. Non-compliance may lead to disciplinary action.

Salary Structure The salary is broken down as follows: - Basic: 40% - HRA: 20% - Special Allowance: 30% - Provident Fund: 10% Salaries are credited by the 5th of every month. Payslips are available on the HR portal.

Termination Policy Either party must give 30 days' notice or pay in lieu. Immediate termination may occur in case of: - Gross Misconduct - Fraud or Theft - Breach of confidentiality Exit interviews are mandatory, and HR clearance is required.

Training Policy Every employee must complete 3 mandatory training sessions annually: - Cybersecurity Awareness - Workplace Ethics - Data Privacy Additional upskilling programs are available upon manager's recommendation. Certificates are issued via the LMS portal.
